title: Papoose And Kid Flash Unleashes 'Cereal Killer' Video
htmlContent:
On Tuesday, six-time certified Platinum and 2X GOLD Cover artist Kid Flash collaborate with New York-based ﻿ artist Papoose. The two artists worked on a project called "Cereal Killer," and JR Swiftz produced it.

Cereal Killer is an animated music video featuring some of the most famous cereals in the world. For example, Apple Jacks, Cap'n Crunch, Fruit Loops, and Frosted Flakes.

The video also depicts a life where Black Love succeeds. Papoose can be seen in a black robe with a hat that says "Black Love." Right before, he asked his wife Remy Ma to make him some cereal.

Earlier this month, Papoose that he would be retiring from rap at the end of 2021, according to Adam Benavides of mxdwn.com. After he released an album called "January." The project features numerous heavyweights in the industry, such as Wiz Khalifa & Brady Watt.
